stem: If the central bank ________ the benchmark interest rate sooner, the domestic currency ________ so significantly against foreign currencies last year.
questionText: If the central bank ________ the benchmark interest rate sooner, the domestic currency ________ so significantly against foreign currencies last year.
options: had raised / would not have depreciated
explanation: Cümle geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir durumu anlattığı için Type 3 Conditional (Past Unreal) yapısı gerektirir: If + Past Perfect (had raised), would + have + V3 (would not have depreciated).

stem: In financial accounting, a company's total ________ represents the debts and financial obligations that it owes to outside parties, such as loans and accounts payable.
questionText: In financial accounting, a company's total ________ represents the debts and financial obligations that it owes to outside parties, such as loans and accounts payable.
explanation: 'Liabilities' (yükümlülükler / borçlar), bir işletmenin dış taraflara olan borç ve taahhütlerini ifade eder. 'Assets' ise varlıklar demektir.

stem: ________ experiencing volatile market fluctuations in the first quarter, the state bank managed to report record net profitability by year-end.
questionText: ________ experiencing volatile market fluctuations in the first quarter, the state bank managed to report record net profitability by year-end.
explanation: 'In spite of' (veya Despite) kendisinden sonra isim öbeği veya -ing (gerund) alır ve zıtlık bildirir: 'In spite of experiencing...'. 'Although' ise tam bir cümle (özne + yüklem) gerektirirdi.

stem: The financial institution immediately notified its regulatory authorities and affected customers following a severe data ________ that compromised sensitive account credentials.
questionText: The financial institution immediately notified its regulatory authorities and affected customers following a severe data ________ that compromised sensitive account credentials.
explanation: 'Data breach' (veri ihlali/sızıntısı), hassas verilerin yetkisiz kişilerin eline geçmesi durumudur.

stem: Machine learning algorithms, ________ ability to identify subtle patterns in massive transaction streams is well documented, are increasingly deployed for real-time fraud prevention.
questionText: Machine learning algorithms, ________ ability to identify subtle patterns in massive transaction streams is well documented, are increasingly deployed for real-time fraud prevention.
explanation: Burada sahiplik (iyelik) ilişkisi vardır: 'Algoritmaların yeteneği' anlamını vermek için 'whose + noun' (whose ability) yapısı kullanılır.

stem: The new risk management guidelines ________ by the supervisory banking authority before the close of the current fiscal quarter.
questionText: The new risk management guidelines ________ by the supervisory banking authority before the close of the current fiscal quarter.
explanation: Cümle gelecekte denetleyici kurum tarafından uygulanacak kuralları anlatan bir edilgen (Passive Voice) yapıdır: 'will be implemented' (uygulanacaktır).

stem: Commercial banks often require borrowers to pledge physical property or securities as ________ to guarantee the repayment of substantial business loans.
questionText: Commercial banks often require borrowers to pledge physical property or securities as ________ to guarantee the repayment of substantial business loans.
explanation: 'Collateral' (teminat, rehin, ipotek), kredi geri ödemesini güvence altına almak için bankaya sunulan varlıktır.

stem: ________ traditional retail branches continue to experience declining foot traffic, mobile banking applications are registering unprecedented user engagement.
questionText: ________ traditional retail branches continue to experience declining foot traffic, mobile banking applications are registering unprecedented user engagement.
explanation: 'While' (veya Whereas), iki durum arasındaki zıtlığı belirtmek için tam bir yan cümlenin (Subject + Verb) başında kullanılır: 'Geleneksel şubeler azalırken, mobil bankacılık rekor kırıyor'. 'Despite' arkasından tam cümle alamaz.

stem: Digital payment transactions now ________ more than sixty percent of the total retail banking turnover in metropolitan areas.
questionText: Digital payment transactions now ________ more than sixty percent of the total retail banking turnover in metropolitan areas.
explanation: 'Account for' (oluşturmak, tekabül etmek, açıklamak), bir bütünün belirli bir oranını oluşturmak anlamına gelir ('account for more than 60%').

stem: A persistent rise in raw material and energy prices often triggers ________ pressures throughout an economy, prompting consumers to cut discretionary spending.
questionText: A persistent rise in raw material and energy prices often triggers ________ pressures throughout an economy, prompting consumers to cut discretionary spending.
explanation: 'Inflationary pressures' (enflasyonist baskılar), fiyatlar genel düzeyinin yukarı doğru itilmesini ifade eden yaygın bir ekonomi terimidir.

stem: The automated payment system failed during peak hours; the engineers ________ the stress-test simulations thoroughly before deployment.
questionText: The automated payment system failed during peak hours; the engineers ________ the stress-test simulations thoroughly before deployment.
explanation: 'Should have + V3' (yapmalıydı ama yapmadı), geçmişe yönelik pişmanlık veya yerine getirilmemiş bir gerekliliği ifade eder: 'Mühendisler sistemi canlıya almadan önce simülasyonları yapmalıydı'.

stem: Treasury bonds that have a 10-year ________ will pay fixed semi-annual coupon interest until the principal amount is reimbursed.
questionText: Treasury bonds that have a 10-year ________ will pay fixed semi-annual coupon interest until the principal amount is reimbursed.
explanation: 'Maturity' (vade / vade sonu), bir finansal borç veya yatırım aracının anaparasının geri ödeneceği son tarihtir.

stem: The central bank decided to lower reserve requirements ________ commercial lenders could provide more liquidity to private sector enterprises.
questionText: The central bank decided to lower reserve requirements ________ commercial lenders could provide more liquidity to private sector enterprises.
explanation: 'So that' (-sın diye / amacıyla), amaç bildiren bir bağlaçtır ve kendisinden sonra cümle ile birlikte sıklıkla 'could / can / may' modalları kullanılır.

stem: While the database administrators ________ the customer records to the newly installed servers, an unexpected network timeout interrupted the synchronization process.
questionText: While the database administrators ________ the customer records to the newly installed servers, an unexpected network timeout interrupted the synchronization process.
explanation: 'While' ile başlayan yan cümlede geçmişte devam eden bir eylem (Past Continuous: 'were migrating') anlatılırken, diğer cümlede onu bölen anlık eylem Past Simple ('interrupted') ile ifade edilir.

stem: Our fintech subsidiary ________ biometric authentication solutions for regional banks since early 2021 without reporting any major downtime.
questionText: Our fintech subsidiary ________ biometric authentication solutions for regional banks since early 2021 without reporting any major downtime.
explanation: 'Since early 2021' zaman ifadesi geçmişte başlayıp günümüze kadar kesintisiz devam eden süreçleri belirtmek için Present Perfect Continuous ('has been providing') gerektirir.

stem: The account balance looks completely unchanged; the automated payment order ________ processed yet by the clearinghouse.
questionText: The account balance looks completely unchanged; the automated payment order ________ processed yet by the clearinghouse.
explanation: 'Cannot have been + V3', geçmişe veya mevcut sonuca dayalı güçlü bir olumsuz çıkarım ('işlenmiş olamaz') ifade eder. Bakiye hiç değişmediğine göre işlemin gerçekleşmiş olması imkansız görünmektedir.

stem: All corporate loan applications above five million lira ________ currently ________ by the senior credit committee to prevent non-performing assets.
questionText: All corporate loan applications above five million lira ________ currently ________ by the senior credit committee to prevent non-performing assets.
explanation: 'Currently' (şu anda) ifadesi ve eylemin başkası tarafından yapılması (komite tarafından incelenmesi) nedeniyle Present Continuous Passive ('are being reviewed') yapısı doğrudur. Özne çoğul ('applications') olduğu için 'are' kullanılır.

stem: If our branch ________ specialized loan officers for agricultural clients, we ________ faster evaluation of farming subsidies right now.
questionText: If our branch ________ specialized loan officers for agricultural clients, we ________ faster evaluation of farming subsidies right now.
explanation: Şu anki varsayımsal durumu (şu an uzmanımız olsaydı, şu an daha hızlı yapardık) ifade eden Type 2 Conditional kuralı: 'If + Past Simple, could / would + V1' kalıbıdır ('had / could deliver').

stem: Commercial banking entities are legally required to strictly comply ________ anti-money laundering (AML) regulations established by the financial crimes investigation board.
questionText: Commercial banking entities are legally required to strictly comply ________ anti-money laundering (AML) regulations established by the financial crimes investigation board.
explanation: 'Comply' fiili daima 'with' edatıyla birlikte kullanılır: 'comply with regulations' (yönetmeliklere/kurallara uymak).

stem: Smallholder farmers who maintain a clean credit history are eligible ________ subsidized interest rate loans provided through official rural development funds.
questionText: Smallholder farmers who maintain a clean credit history are eligible ________ subsidized interest rate loans provided through official rural development funds.
explanation: 'Eligible' sıfatı bir hakka veya avantaja uygunluğu belirtirken 'for' edatı alır: 'eligible for a loan' (krediye uygun / kredi alma hakkına sahip).

stem: Over the past five years, state-owned banks have invested heavily ________ cloud-native core banking infrastructure to enhance operational agility.
questionText: Over the past five years, state-owned banks have invested heavily ________ cloud-native core banking infrastructure to enhance operational agility.
explanation: 'Invest' fiili bir şeye/alana yatırım yapıldığında 'in' edatı ile kullanılır: 'invest in cloud infrastructure' (bulut altyapısına yatırım yapmak).

stem: The auditing team inspected two different accounting software vendors, but ________ of them met the strict fault-tolerance standards outlined in the tender.
questionText: The auditing team inspected two different accounting software vendors, but ________ of them met the strict fault-tolerance standards outlined in the tender.
explanation: İki seçenekten bahsederken ('two different vendors') her ikisinin de sağlamadığını (olumsuz) belirtmek için 'neither of them' kullanılır. 'None' ise ikiden fazla seçenek için kullanılır.

stem: We sincerely appreciate your prompt inquiry and look forward to ________ our strategic partnership during the forthcoming annual financial conference.
questionText: We sincerely appreciate your prompt inquiry and look forward to ________ our strategic partnership during the forthcoming annual financial conference.
explanation: 'Look forward to' deyimindeki 'to' bir edattır (preposition). Preposition'lardan sonra gelen fiiller daima Gerund (-ing) alır: 'look forward to expanding'.

stem: To prevent unauthorized access, IT security policies strictly prohibit staff members from ________ confidential credentials via unencrypted messaging channels.
questionText: To prevent unauthorized access, IT security policies strictly prohibit staff members from ________ confidential credentials via unencrypted messaging channels.
explanation: 'Prohibit somebody from doing something' kalıbında, 'from' edatından sonra fiil -ing (gerund) takısı almalıdır: 'from transmitting'.

stem: At the annual general assembly, the board recommended distributing a cash ________ of 1.20 TL per share to shareholders out of retained earnings.
questionText: At the annual general assembly, the board recommended distributing a cash ________ of 1.20 TL per share to shareholders out of retained earnings.
explanation: 'Dividend' (kâr payı / temettü), bir şirketin elde ettiği kârdan hisse sahiplerine hisse başına dağıttığı paydır.

stem: During periods of rapid capital outflows, commercial banks can face a severe ________ squeeze if interbank lending rates skyrocket unexpectedly.
questionText: During periods of rapid capital outflows, commercial banks can face a severe ________ squeeze if interbank lending rates skyrocket unexpectedly.
explanation: 'Liquidity squeeze' (likidite sıkışıklığı), piyasada nakit veya kolay nakde çevrilebilir varlıkların yetersiz kalması durumudur.

stem: Under the standard loan agreement, the gradual repayment of the debt principal along with regular interest charges over time is referred to as ________.
questionText: Under the standard loan agreement, the gradual repayment of the debt principal along with regular interest charges over time is referred to as ________.
explanation: 'Amortization' (itfa / amortisman / borç tükenimi), bir kredinin ana para ve faizinin belirlenen bir geri ödeme planına göre taksitlerle kademeli olarak kapatılmasıdır.

stem:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word:
"Exchange rates tend to *fluctuate* dramatically whenever central banks unexpectedly alter their interest rate guidance."
questionText:
Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word:
"Exchange rates tend to *fluctuate* dramatically whenever central banks unexpectedly alter their interest rate guidance."
explanation: 'Fluctuate' (dalgalanmak, değişkenlik göstermek) kelimesinin en yakın anlamlısı 'vary' (farklılaşmak, değişmek) kelimesidir.

stem: The IT department intends to ________ outmoded mainframe architectures and replace them with modular microservice architectures by next year.
questionText: The IT department intends to ________ outmoded mainframe architectures and replace them with modular microservice architectures by next year.
explanation: 'Phase out' (kademeli olarak sonlandırmak / kullanımdan kaldırmak), eski bir sistem veya ürünün yerine yenisi konurken yavaşça devreden çıkarılmasıdır.

stem: ________ the macroeconomic climate remained challenging throughout the fiscal year, the agricultural credit portfolio showed surprisingly low default rates.
questionText: ________ the macroeconomic climate remained challenging throughout the fiscal year, the agricultural credit portfolio showed surprisingly low default rates.
explanation: 'Even though' (-e rağmen / her ne kadar ... olsa da) tam cümle ile zıtlık bildiren bir yan cümle bağlacıdır. Makroekonomik şartlar zorlu olmasına rağmen batık kredi oranının düşük çıkması zıtlıktır.

stem: Due to unforeseen hardware maintenance in the central data warehouse, ________.
questionText: Due to unforeseen hardware maintenance in the central data warehouse, ________.
options: all overnight batch settlement jobs were postponed until the following morning
because the mobile banking application functioned without any latency
which caused customers to express great satisfaction with banking speed
if the credit card verification system had operated seamlessly
in spite of the prompt resolution of all customer inquiries
explanation: 'Due to ...' (nedeniyle) bir sebep bildiren zarf öbeğidir ve arkasından mantıklı bir sonuç ana cümlesi gerektirir: 'Merkezi depodaki bakım nedeniyle tüm gece mutabakat işleri ertesi sabaha ertelendi.'

stem:

"(A) *Each of* the regional branches (B) *have reported* a notable increase in (C) *digital loan applications* (D) *since* the revised mobile interface (E) *was released*."
questionText:
Identify the underlined part that contains a grammatical error:

"(A) *Each of* the regional branches (B) *have reported* a notable increase in (C) *digital loan applications* (D) *since* the revised mobile interface (E) *was released*."
explanation: 'Each of + plural noun' yapısı daima tekil fiil (singular verb) gerektirir. 'Each of the regional branches has reported' olmalıdır; 'have reported' dil bilgisi hatasıdır.

stem:
Identify the underlined part that contains a grammatical error:

questionText:
Identify the underlined part that contains a grammatical error:

"The newly launched (A) *fraud detection* system operates (B) *remarkable* (C) *efficiently* by cross-referencing customer location data (D) *with* ongoing POS transaction (E) *records*."
explanation: 'Efficiently' bir zarftır (adverb). Bir zarfı nitelemek için sıfat ('remarkable') değil, başka bir zarf kullanılmalıdır: 'remarkably efficiently' (kayda değer derecede verimli).

questionText:
Complete the dialogue:

Customer: "Good morning, I tried to make a SWIFT transfer to my supplier abroad, but the system displayed an error code 'ERR-402'."
Bank Representative: "________"

Would you like to open a multi-currency foreign exchange deposit account today?

The foreign exchange rate has just increased by five percent since yesterday.
You cannot cancel an international transaction once it is cleared.
explanation: Müşterinin 'Hayır, bunu kontrol etmemiştim, hemen IBAN ve BIC kodlarına bakayım' cevabı; temsilcinin alıcının şube/SWIFT kodlarının doğruluğunu soran bir soru yönelttiğini gösterir.

questionText:
Complete the dialogue:

Loan Analyst: "I cannot access the risk score dashboard this morning. The screen keeps prompting me for secondary authorization."
Security Administrator: "We rolled out mandatory two-factor authentication (2FA) for all intranet tools over the weekend."
Loan Analyst: "Oh, I see. What should I do next to log in?"
Security Administrator: "________"
options: Simply open the corporate authenticator app on your registered smartphone and enter the 6-digit passcode.

We will probably cancel all customer loans that were submitted last week.
Please deposit twenty lira to renew your debit card subscription.

"The modern banking sector has witnessed an unprecedented transformation over the last decade. Traditional branch-centric operations are rapidly giving way to digital-first banking paradigms. questionText:
Read the text and choose the best option for blank [1]:

Consequently, financial institutions must continuously update their legacy software architectures [1] ________ cyber threats become ever more sophisticated."
explanation: 'As' burada '-dıkça / çünkü' (as cyber threats become...) anlamında sebep veya eş zamanlı gelişim bildirmektedir: 'Siber tehditler daha sofistike hale geldikçe kurumlar yazılımlarını güncellemelidir'.

explanation: 'Even if' (-se bile / olsa dahi), koşullu zıtlık bildirir: 'Altyapı sağlam olsa bile, sezgisel bir arayüz sunamayan mobil uygulamalar pazar payını kaybetme riski taşır'.

questionText:
Answer the question according to the text below:

"Open Banking represents a regulatory and technological framework that mandates financial institutions to share customer-permissioned financial data with certified third-party providers via standardized Application Programming Interfaces (APIs). In Turkey, regulatory frameworks spearheaded by the Central Bank (TCMB) and the Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency (BDDK) have established robust security standards for open banking implementations, such as Account Information Services (AIS) and Payment Initiation Services (PIS). While incumbent commercial banks initially perceived open banking as a threat to their proprietary customer data, many have now embraced it as an opportunity to expand their digital ecosystem by partnering with agile fintech startups."

According to the passage, what is the primary role of APIs in Open Banking?
options: They allow secure sharing of customer-approved financial data with certified third-party providers.
They completely eliminate the need for supervisory banking oversight bodies like BDDK.
They permanently replace all physical bank branches with automated teller machines.
They guarantee that bank deposit interest rates remain permanently fixed.
They enable customers to bypass all authentication requirements during online purchases.
explanation: Metnin ilk cümlesinde açıkça belirtilmiştir: 'mandates financial institutions to share customer-permissioned financial data with certified third-party providers via standardized Application Programming Interfaces (APIs)'.

stem: According to the passage on Open Banking, how has the perspective of incumbent commercial banks changed over time?
questionText: According to the passage on Open Banking, how has the perspective of incumbent commercial banks changed over time?
options: They initially viewed it as a threat to their proprietary data, but now see it as an opportunity to collaborate with fintechs.
They completely refused to comply with regulatory standards published by TCMB.
They decided to stop all mobile software development and return to branch banking.
They merged all of their credit card divisions into a single unified state institution.
They ceased offering payment initiation services due to excessive operating expenses.
explanation: Metnin son cümlesinde: 'While incumbent commercial banks initially perceived open banking as a threat to their proprietary customer data, many have now embraced it as an opportunity to expand their digital ecosystem by partnering with agile fintech startups' ifadesi yer almaktadır.

stem: What can be inferred from the passage regarding Open Banking in Turkey?
questionText: What can be inferred from the passage regarding Open Banking in Turkey?
options: Open banking services operate within a strictly regulated environment supervised by official authorities such as TCMB and BDDK.
Third-party providers can access user banking data without obtaining explicit customer consent.
Turkish banks are technologically behind foreign banks and cannot implement API standards.
Payment Initiation Services are prohibited under current Turkish banking legislation.
Customer financial data is made publicly readable on the internet without any encryption.
explanation: Metinde TCMB ve BDDK öncülüğünde sağlam güvenlik standartlarının getirildiği açıkça vurgulanmaktadır. Bu da açık bankacılığın resmi otoritelerce sıkı biçimde düzenlenen ve denetlenen bir ortamda çalıştığını gösterir.

stem: The internal audit team was instructed to ________ a thorough investigation into the unauthorized transactions reported last month.
questionText: The internal audit team was instructed to ________ a thorough investigation into the unauthorized transactions reported last month.
explanation: 'Carry out' bir araştırmayı, görevi, denetimi veya planı 'yürütmek, uygulamak, icra etmek' anlamına gelir. 'Call off' iptal etmek, 'turn down' reddetmek, 'give up' vazgeçmek demektir.

stem: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) ________ more than 60 percent of total commercial employment in the domestic economy.
questionText: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) ________ more than 60 percent of total commercial employment in the domestic economy.
explanation: 'Account for' bir orana, sayıya veya yüzdeye 'tekabül etmek, oluşturmak' anlamında sınavlarda en çok çıkan phrasal verb'lerden biridir. Cümlede 'KOBİ'ler toplam istihdamın %60'ından fazlasını oluşturmaktadır' denmektedir.

stem: Persistently high interest rates and restrictive credit conditions may significantly ________ the growth of private investments.
questionText: Persistently high interest rates and restrictive credit conditions may significantly ________ the growth of private investments.
explanation: 'Hamper' engellemek, köstek olmak, güçleştirmek anlamına gelir (eş anlamlılar: hinder, impede). Cümle mantığında yüksek faiz oranları yatırımları kolaylaştırmaz (facilitate) veya hızlandırmaz (accelerate), aksine engeller / yavaşlatır (hamper).

stem: Because their export revenues depend predominantly on a single raw material, developing economies remain exceptionally ________ to external price shocks.
questionText: Because their export revenues depend predominantly on a single raw material, developing economies remain exceptionally ________ to external price shocks.
explanation: 'Vulnerable to' bir tehlikeye, şoka veya olumsuzluğa karşı 'savunmasız, hassas' olmak anlamına gelir. 'Immune to' bağışık olmak, 'resistant to' dirençli olmak demektir.

stem: Following the implementation of digital core banking software, customer transaction processing times decreased ________.
questionText: Following the implementation of digital core banking software, customer transaction processing times decreased ________.
explanation: 'Substantially' (önemli ölçüde, kayda değer şekilde / eş anlamlılar: significantly, considerably, drastically) fiili niteleyen en uygun zarftır. İşlem süreleri 'önemli ölçüde azalmıştır'. 'Reluctantly' isteksizce demektir.

stem: Analysts emphasized that the banking panic did not occur randomly; it ________ deep-rooted structural weaknesses in risk governance.
questionText: Analysts emphasized that the banking panic did not occur randomly; it ________ deep-rooted structural weaknesses in risk governance.
explanation: 'Stem from' -den kaynaklanmak, ileri gelmek anlamına gelir (originate from, derive from). Panik 'risk yönetimindeki köklü yapısal zayıflıklardan kaynaklandı'.

stem: When a commercial borrower fails to meet scheduled interest or principal payments, the credit facility is considered to be in ________.
questionText: When a commercial borrower fails to meet scheduled interest or principal payments, the credit facility is considered to be in ________.
explanation: 'In default' (temerrüt hali), borçlunun kredi veya faiz ödeme yükümlülüğünü yerine getirememesi durumudur. 'Surplus' fazla, 'dividend' temettü (kâr payı) demektir.

stem: To restore confidence in financial markets, the regulatory authority introduced stringent measures to ________ illicit money flows and tax evasion.
questionText: To restore confidence in financial markets, the regulatory authority introduced stringent measures to ________ illicit money flows and tax evasion.
explanation: 'Curb' frenlemek, dizginlemek, sınırlamak anlamına gelir (eş anlamlılar: restrict, restrain). Yasa dışı para akışını ve vergi kaçakçılığını 'dizginlemek / engellemek' için sıkı tedbirler getirilmiştir. 'Foster' teşvik etmek, 'magnify' büyütmek demektir.

stem: ________ severe macroeconomic headwinds and currency volatility, the national commercial bank achieved an impressive 18 percent increase in annual net profit.
questionText: ________ severe macroeconomic headwinds and currency volatility, the national commercial bank achieved an impressive 18 percent increase in annual net profit.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra bir isim öbeği (severe macroeconomic headwinds... - Noun Phrase) gelmiştir ve cümlenin ilk kısmı olumsuz (-) iken ana cümle kâr artışı ile olumludur (+). Zıtlık bildiren ve arkasından isim öbeği alan edat 'Despite'dır. 'Although' arkasından tam cümle (Özne + Yüklem) gerektirirdi.

stem: ________ digital banking applications offer unprecedented convenience for daily retail payments, they simultaneously expose financial institutions to sophisticated cyber threats.
questionText: ________ digital banking applications offer unprecedented convenience for daily retail payments, they simultaneously expose financial institutions to sophisticated cyber threats.
explanation: 'While' cümle başında kullanıldığında 'Although / -e rağmen' veya 'iken' anlamında iki durum arasındaki karşıtlığı kurar (bir yanda kolaylık sağlamasına rağmen diğer yanda siber tehditlere maruz bırakmaktadır). Arkasından tam cümle aldığı için 'In spite of' (isim alır) elenir.

stem: The executive management decided to suspend the overseas branch expansion ________ deteriorating geopolitical conditions in the region.
questionText: The executive management decided to suspend the overseas branch expansion ________ deteriorating geopolitical conditions in the region.
explanation: Boşluktan sonra 'deteriorating geopolitical conditions' (kötüleşen jeopolitik koşullar) isim öbeği gelmektedir. Şubenin askıya alınmasının 'sebebi' anlatılmaktadır. İsim öbeği ile kullanılan sebep bağlacı 'Due to'dur (-den dolayı). 'Even though' ve 'Whereas' tam cümle ister.

stem: Cross-border payment settlements cannot be finalized ________ all participating correspondent banks fully verify the authenticity of the transaction credentials.
questionText: Cross-border payment settlements cannot be finalized ________ all participating correspondent banks fully verify the authenticity of the transaction credentials.
explanation: 'Unless' (= if not / -medikçe, -madıkça) şart bildirir. 'Katılımcı muhabir bankalar kimlik bilgilerini tam olarak doğrulamadıkça ödemeler tamamlanamaz'. Anlamsal olarak 'unless' gereklidir.

stem: The fintech startup struggled to obtain venture capital funding during its initial two years; ________, its innovative credit scoring algorithm eventually gained widespread market adoption.
questionText: The fintech startup struggled to obtain venture capital funding during its initial two years; ________, its innovative credit scoring algorithm eventually gained widespread market adoption.
explanation: Noktalı virgül (;) ve virgül (,) arasında zıtlık geçişi aranmaktadır. İlk cümlede fon bulmakta zorlandığı (-) söylenirken, ikinci cümlede algoritmasının geniş kabul gördüğü (+) belirtilmiştir. Bu zıtlığı 'nevertheless' (yine de, buna rağmen / eş anlamlı: however, nonetheless) sağlar. 'Therefore' ve 'as a result' sonuç bildirir.

stem: Since the banking regulatory authority ________ mandatory multi-factor authentication rules in 2021, online identity theft incidents ________ by nearly 45 percent.
questionText: Since the banking regulatory authority ________ mandatory multi-factor authentication rules in 2021, online identity theft incidents ________ by nearly 45 percent.
explanation: Klasik ve değişmez SINCE kuralı: 'Since + Simple Past (V2), Present Perfect (have/has + V3)'. Otorite 2021'de kuralı getirdiğinden beri (introduced), olaylar azalmıştır (have declined).

stem: As soon as the monetary policy committee ________ its benchmark interest rate decision tomorrow, commercial lenders ________ their deposit yields accordingly.
questionText: As soon as the monetary policy committee ________ its benchmark interest rate decision tomorrow, commercial lenders ________ their deposit yields accordingly.
explanation: Zaman bağlaçları (as soon as, when, after, before) yan cümlesinde ASLA 'will' almaz! Cümle yarını (future) anlattığı için: Yan cümle Present Simple ('announces'), ana cümle Future ('will adjust') olur.

stem: Confidential financial records ________ on unencrypted portable storage devices under any circumstances, as specified in banking data compliance policies.
questionText: Confidential financial records ________ on unencrypted portable storage devices under any circumstances, as specified in banking data compliance policies.
explanation: Özne 'Confidential financial records' (gizli finansal kayıtlar) cansız bir nesnedir ve depolayan değil depolanandır, yani EDİLGEN (Passive: be + V3) olmalıdır. Ayrıca kesin bir yasaklama ('under any circumstances') anlatıldığı için 'must not be stored' (saklanmamalıdır / saklanması yasaktır) doğru yapıdır.

stem: ________ the senior risk auditor identified the fraudulent transactions earlier, the substantial financial loss could easily have been prevented.
questionText: ________ the senior risk auditor identified the fraudulent transactions earlier, the substantial financial loss could easily have been prevented.
explanation: Ana cümlede 'could have been prevented' (Type 3 Conditional) kullanılmıştır. Şart cümlesi 'If the auditor had identified...' yerine 'If' kaldırılarak DEVRİK (Inversion) yapılmıştır: 'Had the auditor identified...'. Cümle başında 'Had + Özne + V3' yapısı Type 3 devrik şart cümlesidir.

stem: The supervisory committee summoned the chief executive, ________ strategic decisions during the acquisition process had raised serious regulatory concerns.
questionText: The supervisory committee summoned the chief executive, ________ strategic decisions during the acquisition process had raised serious regulatory concerns.
explanation: 'Whose' bir ismin sahipliğini belirtmek için kullanılır (chief executive's strategic decisions ➔ CEO'nun stratejik kararları). 'Kişi + whose + isim' kalıbı doğrudan 'whose' gerektirir.

stem: The cyber attackers ________ valid administrative credentials to bypass the core firewall; otherwise, the automated security intrusion alarm would have gone off immediately.
questionText: The cyber attackers ________ valid administrative credentials to bypass the core firewall; otherwise, the automated security intrusion alarm would have gone off immediately.
explanation: Geçmişe dair güçlü bir çıkarım (strong deduction) vardır: 'Saldırganlar güvenlik duvarını aşmak için geçerli yönetici kimlik bilgilerini KULLANMIŞ OLMALILAR (must have used); aksi takdirde alarm çalardı'. 'Should have used' kullanmalıydı ama kullanmadı anlamına gelir ve anlama uymaz.

stem: Although modern algorithmic trading systems execute high-frequency orders in mere microseconds, ________.
questionText: Although modern algorithmic trading systems execute high-frequency orders in mere microseconds, ________.
options: they can occasionally amplify sudden market volatility when unexpected systemic shocks occur
they have completely eliminated the risk of financial loss for retail investors
because computerized trading models are infallible and guarantee continuous profits
so financial regulatory bodies encourage unmonitored flash order operations
which proves that human traders are no longer needed under any circumstances
explanation: Cümle 'Although' (Zıtlık) ile başlamaktadır. İlk kısım sistemin hızı ve gelişmişliğiyle olumludur (+). Virgülden sonraki ana cümlenin olumsuz (-) bir yönü veya riski anlatması gerekir: 'beklenmedik şoklarda ani piyasa oynaklığını büyütebilmektedirler'. A şıkkı bu zıtlığı kusursuz biçimde tamamlar.

stem: Unless a commercial enterprise maintains a sufficient buffer of high-quality liquid assets, ________.
questionText: Unless a commercial enterprise maintains a sufficient buffer of high-quality liquid assets, ________.
options: it may find itself unable to honor short-term obligations during unexpected credit contractions
it would have enjoyed record high profitability throughout the fiscal year
which guarantees smooth cross-border settlement processing without delays
therefore institutional investors immediately injected surplus equity capital
it easily secured long-term funding at below-market interest rates
explanation: 'Unless' (-medikçe / if not) şartı olumsuz bir durum uyarısı içerir. Yeterli likit varlık tamponu tutmadıkça ➔ 'beklenmedik kredi daralmalarında kısa vadeli yükümlülüklerini yerine getiremez hale gelebilir'. A şıkkı hem zaman (Present/May) hem anlam açısından tam uyumludur.

stem: Because credit rating agencies downgraded the sovereign bond ratings of several emerging nations, ________.
questionText: Because credit rating agencies downgraded the sovereign bond ratings of several emerging nations, ________.
options: international lenders immediately raised risk premiums on future loans extended to those countries
in order that foreign direct investment would pour in without any regulatory restraint
despite the unprecedented resilience of domestic capital market infrastructures
so that commercial banks could easily lower their capital adequacy reserves
which had already repaid their outstanding foreign currency sovereign debts
explanation: 'Because' (Sebep) cümlesinde kredi notlarının düşürüldüğü belirtilmiştir. Bunun mantıksal sonucu: Uluslararası borç verenlerin o ülkelere açılacak kredilerdeki risk primlerini artırmasıdır (A şıkkı).

stem: Central banks conduct routine stress test simulations on systemically important financial institutions in order to ________.
questionText: Central banks conduct routine stress test simulations on systemically important financial institutions in order to ________.
options: assess whether their capital cushions can withstand extreme macroeconomic recessions
guarantee that no financial institution will ever record an operational loss
owing to the complete deregulation of international cross-border fund flows
although commercial banks had already distributed all their surplus dividends
so that speculative cryptocurrency trades could be incorporated into reserve assets
explanation: 'In order to + Fiil' (amaç bildirir - yapmak amacıyla). Merkez bankaları stres testlerini 'sermaye tamponlarının aşırı makroekonomik durgunluklara dayanıp dayanamayacağını değerlendirmek amacıyla' yapar.

stem:
The newly adopted artificial intelligence guidelines require financial institutions to maintain full transparency in their automated credit scoring decisions.

Verilen İngilizce cümlenin en uygun Türkçe karşılığını bulunuz:
questionText:
The newly adopted artificial intelligence guidelines require financial institutions to maintain full transparency in their automated credit scoring decisions.

Verilen İngilizce cümlenin en uygun Türkçe karşılığını bulunuz:
options: Yeni kabul edilen yapay zekâ yönergeleri, finans kuruluşlarının otomatik kredi skorlama kararlarında tam şeffaflık sağlamasını zorunlu kılmaktadır.
Finans kuruluşları, otomatik kredi kararlarında şeffaf olmak amacıyla yeni yapay zekâ kurallarını benimsemiştir.
Yeni yapay zekâ kurallarına göre finans kuruluşlarının otomatik kredi kararlarında şeffaflık sağlaması tavsiye edilmektedir.
Otomatik kredi skorlamasında tam şeffaflık sağlayan finans kuruluşları, yeni yapay zekâ yönergelerini kabul etmiştir.
Yeni kabul edilen yapay zekâ ilkeleri sayesinde finans kuruluşları kredi skorlamasında şeffaflığı artıracaktır.
explanation: Taktik: Cümlenin yüklemi 'require' (zorunlu kılmaktadır / şart koşmaktadır). Özne: 'The newly adopted artificial intelligence guidelines' (Yeni kabul edilen yapay zekâ yönergeleri). A şıkkında özne ve yüklem eksiksiz ve birebir karşılanmıştır. C'de 'tavsiye edilmektedir', B'de 'benimsemiştir', E'de 'artıracaktır' diyerek yüklem bozulmuştur.

stem:
Merkez bankası faiz oranlarını düşürdüğünde, ticari kredilere olan talep genellikle önemli ölçüde artar.

Verilen Türkçe cümlenin en uygun İngilizce karşılığını bulunuz:
questionText:
Merkez bankası faiz oranlarını düşürdüğünde, ticari kredilere olan talep genellikle önemli ölçüde artar.

Verilen Türkçe cümlenin en uygun İngilizce karşılığını bulunuz:
options: When the central bank lowers interest rates, demand for commercial loans generally increases substantially.
If the central bank had lowered interest rates, demand for commercial loans would increase remarkably.
Although the central bank lowered interest rates, demand for commercial loans remained unchanged.
Commercial loans generally increase when the central bank is forced to lower lending rates.
Since the central bank lowers interest rates, the volume of commercial loans has increased dramatically.
explanation: Taktik: Yan cümle 'düşürdüğünde' ➔ 'When the central bank lowers interest rates'. Ana cümlenin yüklemi: 'genellikle önemli ölçüde artar' ➔ 'generally increases substantially'. A şıkkı tam ve hatasız çeviridir.

stem:
Unless internal audit reports are reviewed regularly by executive directors, operational vulnerabilities cannot be detected in a timely manner.

Verilen İngilizce cümlenin en uygun Türkçe karşılığını bulunuz:
questionText:
Unless internal audit reports are reviewed regularly by executive directors, operational vulnerabilities cannot be detected in a timely manner.

Verilen İngilizce cümlenin en uygun Türkçe karşılığını bulunuz:
options: İç denetim raporları icra direktörleri tarafından düzenli olarak incelenmedikçe, operasyonel zafiyetler zamanında tespit edilemez.
İcra direktörleri iç denetim raporlarını düzenli olarak incelese bile operasyonel riskler zamanında tespit edilemeyebilir.
Operasyonel zafiyetlerin zamanında tespit edilmesi, iç denetim raporlarının direktörler tarafından onaylanmasına bağlıdır.
İç denetim raporları düzenli incelenmediği için operasyonel açıkların zamanında belirlenmesi mümkün olmamıştır.
İcra direktörleri iç denetim raporlarını zamanında incelemediği takdirde operasyonel sorunlar ortaya çıkacaktır.
explanation: 'Unless ... reviewed' (-incelenmedikçe / incelenmezse). Ana yüklem: 'cannot be detected in a timely manner' (zamanında tespit edilemez). A şıkkı cümlenin birebir ve doğru çevirisidir.

stem:
Read the passage and answer the question:

'In recent years, the rapid proliferation of decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms has challenged traditional banking paradigms. Proponents argue that smart contracts eliminate intermediaries, drastically reducing transaction fees and processing delays. However, international regulatory authorities warn that the absence of centralized oversight creates severe vulnerabilities to money laundering and automated protocol exploits. Consequently, leading global central banks are now developing Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) to combine the speed of blockchain architecture with the safety of sovereign legal backing.'

What is the primary objective of central banks in developing CBDCs according to the passage?
questionText: What is the primary objective of central banks in developing CBDCs according to the passage?
options: To merge the technological efficiency of blockchain with the legal security and trust of sovereign money.
To completely abolish traditional commercial bank branches within the next decade.
To encourage unmonitored speculative transactions across decentralized financial networks.
To eliminate all legal regulations governing cross-border commercial transactions.
To replace physical cash exclusively with volatile private cryptocurrencies.
explanation: Metnin son cümlesinde: 'combine the speed of blockchain architecture with the safety of sovereign legal backing' (blokzincir hızını egemen devlet güvencesiyle birleştirmek) açıkça belirtilmiştir. A şıkkı bu cümlenin doğrudan karşılığıdır.

stem: According to the passage on decentralized finance (DeFi), what is a major concern raised by international regulatory authorities?
questionText: According to the passage on decentralized finance (DeFi), what is a major concern raised by international regulatory authorities?
options: The lack of centralized supervision makes these platforms susceptible to illicit activities and protocol exploits.
Smart contracts execute financial transactions much too slowly compared to legacy wire systems.
Decentralized platforms demand excessively high intermediary commissions from retail users.
Governments have completely banned all computer programming languages used in finance.
Centralized banks refuse to employ automated IT infrastructure for daily operations.
explanation: Metinde 'absence of centralized oversight creates severe vulnerabilities to money laundering and automated protocol exploits' denilmiştir. Bu da A şıkkındaki 'merkezi denetim eksikliğinin yasadışı faaliyetlere ve protokole yönelik istismarlara zemin hazırlaması' endişesini doğrudan açıklar.

stem: Commercial banks are strictly legally required to comply ________ international anti-money laundering (AML) standards established by FATF.
questionText: Commercial banks are strictly legally required to comply ________ international anti-money laundering (AML) standards established by FATF.
explanation: 'Comply with' (kurallara, standartlara uymak) sınavın en klasik edat eşleşmesidir (prepositional verb). 'Comply' her zaman 'with' edatı ile kullanılır.

stem: The regulatory body decided to deprive the unlicensed broker ________ its operating permission following serious consumer fraud allegations.
questionText: The regulatory body decided to deprive the unlicensed broker ________ its operating permission following serious consumer fraud allegations.
explanation: 'Deprive somebody of something' (birini bir şeyden mahrum bırakmak / elinden almak) yapısıdır. 'Deprive' fiili 'of' edatı ile eşleşir.

stem: The board of directors met on Friday to ________ the proposed merger agreement with the foreign retail bank.
questionText: The board of directors met on Friday to ________ the proposed merger agreement with the foreign retail bank.
explanation: 'Endorse' onaylamak, desteklemek, tasdik etmek anlamına gelir (eş anlamlılar: approve, sanction, support). Yönetim kurulu birleşme anlaşmasını 'onaylamak' için toplanmıştır. 'Deteriorate' kötüleşmek, 'deplete' tüketmek, 'violate' ihlal etmek demektir.

stem: Due to unforeseen scheduling conflicts among executive board members, the quarterly financial audit meeting was ________ until next Tuesday.
questionText: Due to unforeseen scheduling conflicts among executive board members, the quarterly financial audit meeting was ________ until next Tuesday.
explanation: 'Put off' ertelemek (postpone, delay) anlamına gelir. Toplantı gelecek salıya kadar ertelenmiştir. 'Put out' yangın söndürmek, 'take after' birine benzemek demektir.

stem: Financial institutions must refrain from ________ misleading statements concerning the expected returns of complex derivative products.
questionText: Financial institutions must refrain from ________ misleading statements concerning the expected returns of complex derivative products.
explanation: İngilizcede edatlardan (preposition: in, on, at, from, by vb.) sonra fiil her zaman -ING (Gerund) alır. 'Refrain from + V-ing' (bir şey yapmaktan kaçınmak / çekinmek) kuralı gereği doğru cevap 'making'dir.

stem: By the time the new banking regulation comes into full statutory effect next December, most financial firms ________ their compliance protocols.
questionText: By the time the new banking regulation comes into full statutory effect next December, most financial firms ________ their compliance protocols.
explanation: 'By the time + Present Simple' gelecekte bir ana kadar bir işin bitmiş olacağını ifade eder ve ana cümlede mutlaka FUTURE PERFECT (will have + V3) yapısını gerektirir: 'will have completed' (tamamlamış olacaklar).

stem: Gold is traditionally considered a reliable hedge against currency depreciation; ________, corporate bonds offer regular periodic coupon payments.
questionText: Gold is traditionally considered a reliable hedge against currency depreciation; ________, corporate bonds offer regular periodic coupon payments.
explanation: 'On the other hand' (öte yandan / diğer taraftan) iki farklı yatırım aracının (altın vs şirket tahvili) farklı niteliklerini karşılaştırmak için kullanılan geçiş ifadesidir.

stem: The loan facility will be disbursed immediately ________ the applicant submits the legally certified land title as collateral.
questionText: The loan facility will be disbursed immediately ________ the applicant submits the legally certified land title as collateral.
explanation: 'Provided that' (= on condition that / if / -mesi şartıyla) koşul bağlacıdır. Kredi, başvuru sahibinin tapuyu teminat olarak ibraz etmesi 'şartıyla' derhal kullandırılacaktır.

stem: Before embarking on a multimillion-dollar core banking transformation, executive management must conduct a rigorous study to ensure the project is financially ________.
questionText: Before embarking on a multimillion-dollar core banking transformation, executive management must conduct a rigorous study to ensure the project is financially ________.
explanation: 'Feasible' uygulanabilir, yapılabilir, fizıbıl (financially viable) demektir. Projenin finansal olarak 'uygulanabilir' olduğundan emin olmak için fizibilite çalışması yapılır. 'Obsolete' modası geçmiş, 'arbitrary' keyfi demektir.

stem: The internal audit committee could not completely ________ the possibility of senior management involvement in the accounting irregular transactions.
questionText: The internal audit committee could not completely ________ the possibility of senior management involvement in the accounting irregular transactions.
explanation: 'Rule out' ihtimal dışı bırakmak, dışlamak, göz ardı etmek demektir (exclude, eliminate). Denetim komitesi üst yönetimin dahil olma ihtimalini tamamen 'dışlayamadı / göz ardı edemedi'.

stem: Due to growing cyber fraud risks, the board resolved to have their core network infrastructure ________ by an external cybersecurity consultancy.
questionText: Due to growing cyber fraud risks, the board resolved to have their core network infrastructure ________ by an external cybersecurity consultancy.
explanation: Ettirgen çatı (Causative): 'Have something done (V3)'. Bir şeyi birine yaptırmak / denetletmek. Özne 'network infrastructure' cansız olduğundan 'have + object + V3' kalıbı ile 'audited' kullanılır.

stem: In academic economic literature, the term 'liquidity squeeze' most closely refers to a situation in which ________.
questionText: In academic economic literature, the term 'liquidity squeeze' most closely refers to a situation in which ________.
options: cash and readily convertible assets become extremely scarce, making it difficult for institutions to fulfill immediate payment liabilities
interest rates fall to zero and commercial banks refuse to accept customer deposit accounts
companies experience a massive surplus of uninvested capital and pay out record dividends
international trade barriers are eliminated and foreign capital pours uncontrollably into domestic banks
gold reserves increase so fast that the domestic currency experiences sharp deflationary pressures
explanation: 'Liquidity squeeze' (likidite sıkışıklığı), piyasada nakit ve hızla paraya çevrilebilir varlıkların aşırı derecede kıtlaşması ve kurumların acil nakit yükümlülüklerini karşılamakta zorlanması halidir. A şıkkı bu terimin kesin ekonomik tanımıdır.
